when_to_use: use when benchmarking how multiple models translate a ui mockup to react or comparing multiple existing react builds head-to-head.
summary: Runs a pre-benchmark ("pre-bench") or post-benchmark ("post-bench") image-to-React translation, head-to-head build comparison, and tear-apart design evaluation across frontier models (Grok, Claude, Astra, GPT, and Argon) or existing React builds using a locked, minimal zero-drift prompt. Supports single UI images or 4K multi-layout grid sheets, API key discovery with interactive host assistant model offering, headless WebKit2GTK DOM geometry and AutoRaterV1 64x64 cell visual diffing, post-build model self-analysis of image differences and hidden instructions, runnable Golden Template React project generation, and comparative design grading. Use when running a pre-bench warmup from an image or 4K layout grid to React, comparing multiple React builds against a reference design image, or grading image-to-React translations on visual fidelity, CSS integrity, button optical padding, typography, and interactivity.
